snippet.title: Stuntman: Hollywood - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Lights, engine, action! 🎬

Think you have what it takes to survive on the big screen? Step into the driver’s seat in Stuntman: Hollywood!

An action scene is only as good as the stuntman behind the wheel. Perform high-intensity stunts, meet your marks, and show off a little, all to become the greatest stuntman Hollywood has ever seen! ⭐

Coming to Steam, PlayStation 5, and XBOX Series.

🔵 Wishlist now on PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10012107
⚪ Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2487330/Stuntman_Hollywood/
🟢 Wishlist now on XBOX Series: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/stuntman-hollywood/9MWTMX74PJ7S/0010
